body: The satin viscose has real weight to it, not the flimsy kind that clings to tights. I'm 5'6" and it hits right at mid-calf like the photos show. Black is a true black too, no weird sheen under office lighting.

Ordered my usual size and the high waist sits fine but there's a bit of extra room, I might've needed the S instead. Fabric itself is lovely and the A-line shape doesn't add bulk at the hips. Would still buy again, just size down if you're in between.

Wasn't expecting much from a satin skirt at this price but the stitching along the waistband is clean and there's no visible puckering. Wore it with a simple tank and boots and got two compliments at work.

It looked smooth in the product photos but after sitting in it for a couple hours the front is noticeably wrinkled. Doesn't fall out on its own, I have to iron it low heat before wearing again. Fit and length are fine, just wish the fabric held its shape better through the day.
Easy to dress up or down. Zipper on the side takes a little wiggling to get past the hip, loosens up after a few wears though.

She wears a size M usually so I went with that and it fit her well when she tried it on. Came folded in tissue paper which felt a bit more thoughtful than a plain poly bag. She's already asked where I got it so I'd call that a win.

The satin has a nice heavy drape and doesn't wrinkle as badly as some I've owned. I'd say the waist runs slightly small, I could feel it after a big lunch. Length was exactly as described for my height, hits mid-calf.
Comfortable and true to size, no complaints.

I'm on the taller side and expected this to sit closer to my ankle based on the model photos, but it lands a good few inches above where I wanted for a proper midi. The satin quality itself is decent for the price and the color is accurate. Might work better for someone under 5'5".

This is my third satin skirt from different stores and honestly the drape on this one is closer to the pricier brands than I expected. Pairs well with a plain white shirt tucked in, or a fitted sweater in cooler weather. One small thing, the inner lining bunches a little when I sit down for long periods, not a dealbreaker.

This is such a good basic. Goes with sneakers for daytime or heels for evening, doesn't feel like it's trying too hard either way. The elastic panel at the back waist means it's still comfortable after a full day, which I wasn't expecting from something this structured looking.

The satin feels closer to a lining fabric than something meant to be worn as the outer layer, and you can see panty lines through it under bright light. Waist was also loose even in my normal size. Returning this one, disappointed since the photos looked much more substantial.

arrived way faster than i expected, like 3 days. skirt itself is gorgeous, the black has a subtle sheen without looking cheap or shiny under normal light. wearing it to a dinner this weekend and honestly kind of excited about it lol

For what it costs I think this is a solid piece, feels more expensive than the tag suggests. One thing I'd mention is it needs a delicate wash cycle or the satin starts to lose its smoothness fast, learned that the hard way after washing it with regular clothes the first time.
